deployments_detail.use: AI-powered inspection and metrology solutions for defect detection, automated classification and measurement accuracy; acquired AI firm Visual Layer to strengthen platform
AI-Based Defect Detection in semiconductor wafer inspection
AI Classification for automatic defect classification (AiDC)
Visual Layer acquisition to deepen visual AI capabilities in inspection and metrology [Visual Layer]

AiDC (AI Classification): real-time, on-tool AI inference that automatically classifies defects during the inspection scan, eliminating manual review and reducing human error; features automated labeling with false-call reduction and model training workflows. [Camtek (in-house / Camtek AI Center, ex-Visual Layer)]

Enhanced Detection Capabilities (EDC): AI-powered real-time defect filtering that distinguishes critical from non-critical defects, using real-time machine-learning models to improve defect-of-interest detection accuracy; embedded in the Hawk platform. [Camtek (in-house)]

2D AI-Based Defect Detection ('AI Inside'): image-based inspection solution using state-of-the-art AI/deep learning to deliver highly accurate defect identification on full-wafer 2D inspection tools (e.g. Eagle-i). [Camtek (in-house)]

Automated Defect Classification (ADC) software: image-based defect classification tool built on machine-learning technologies with built-in re-training, a flexible classification-engine structure and a review/qualification environment for semiconductor quality control. [Camtek (in-house)]

Hawk advanced-packaging inspection & metrology platform: uses real-time machine-learning models (EDC) to enhance defect-of-interest detection for chiplets, HBM and hybrid bonding, with sensitivity down to 0.1 micron. [Camtek (in-house)]

Acquisition of Visual Layer (Tel Aviv visual-AI / computer-vision & deep-learning analytics company), now operating as the Camtek AI Center; its annotation, acquisition and classification technology had already been integrated into Camtek products for over a year and full ownership was acquired to build a center of excellence. [Visual Layer (acquired) / Camtek AI Center]
deployments_detail.value: Visual Layer had raised $7M to date

deployments_detail.use: Dedicated AI-based software product line: Camtek plans to package and sell AI software (AI-based algorithms improving throughput, detection sensitivity, false-alarm rates and measurement accuracy) to existing customers across Eagle G5 and Hawk systems, potentially as recurring revenue; new AI features to be integrated over the coming months. [Camtek (in-house / Camtek AI Center)]
deployments_detail.value: AI-related products drove ~50% of Q1 2026 revenue
